name: registry
description: The Project Owner's registry surface: register people, register workflow agents (endpoint and centre), register their instances, read contacts and registrations, and check health.
notes: The registry authorizes by caller_type, not by the domain capability tiers, so this card claims no capabilities. Its token must be caller_type=project_owner; that is what opens register_principal and get_principal_contact at all.

kind=centre requires project_owner and refuses a non-empty principal_id (centre_principal_must_be_empty). The Centre Agent has no owner, so registering it as somebody's agent would make its deliveries look attributable to a researcher.
kind=endpoint is the researcher's own agent. The Owner may register it on their behalf, and register_agent_instance then passes through _require_self_or_owner.

Registering an agent is not the same as it being reachable. Delivery needs status=active AND at least one instance with runtime_status=online (adapter_registry.py); registering without an instance produces an agent nobody can deliver to.

tools.name: register_principal
tools.description: Register or update a principal and its notification contact.

tools.name: register_workflow_agent
tools.description: Register or update a workflow agent owned by the caller or Project Owner.

tools.name: register_agent_instance
tools.description: Register or refresh one runtime instance of a workflow agent.

tools.name: get_principal_contact
tools.description: Resolve the current active notification contact for a principal.

tools.name: get_agent_registration
tools.description: Read one workflow agent registration and its runtime instances.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated Registry service and storage health.
